_source.describes: The Caves generator: FLAIL!'s five d6 theme axes, and what a dropped d6 makes of a chamber.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: FLAIL!'s own Caves tables, reproduced in face order, which the Third-Party Licence permits. The axes share their names with the Dungeons generator but deliberately not their field paths: a lock stores a row's position, so sharing a path between two different tables would let a lock taken on a dungeon resolve silently against a cave. 'chambers' is the d6 read off each dropped die, so the same number really does mean the same content the book says it does.

chambers: Treasure: buried chest, weapons cache, spellbook or Unique Item
Vestiges: bone altar, makeshift shelter, burial mound or warding totem
Obstacle: roll or choose a fitting dungeon obstacle
Weak encounter: pick or create a weak creature matching the rolled theme
Average encounter: pick or create an average creature matching the rolled theme
Strong encounter: pick or create a powerful creature matching the rolled theme
